scope: Proposition 2.1 (Compatible Adams lift) of the manuscript “Filtered products and boundary-preserving compression in complex cobordism” (preprints/Filtered-products-and-boundary-preserving-compression-in-complex-cobordism-September-25-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 302 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 c47745026b3a083c), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 5. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let R be a commutative ring spectrum, let G ⊂ E be a finite pointed CW pair, let d ∈ Z, and let v : Σ∞E → ΣdS be a stable map whose restriction to Σ∞G becomes null in ΣdR. For integers 1 ≤ n ≤ ℓ, let Uℓ,n ⊂ E∧ℓ be the union requiring at least n factors in G. Then the restriction of v∧ℓ admits a lift Σ∞ Uℓ,n −→ Σdℓ I∧n R through ΣdℓφR,n.
